summary: Frontend-only regression for iteration 14 — activation system completely removed. All acceptance criteria PASSED: (1) signup subtitle is 'Your scans stay private on this phone' (no '7-day free trial'); (2) HOME has trial-banner=0, header-activate=0, and no forbidden words ('Activate', 'Device ID', 'License', 'GCash', 'trial', 'Trial'); (3) ABOUT has about-activate=0, about-privacy present, Version 1.0.4 shown, no forbidden words; (4) direct navigation to /activate renders Expo Router's 'Unmatched Route / Page could not be found' — no crash, no red screen, no activation UI; (5) simulating expired trial (localStorage trial_start_ms=1, device_activated removed) followed by reload keeps the user on Home with FAB accessible and trial-banner still zero, bootstrap-screen never stuck; (6) signup->Home, header-logout->login, sign-in->Home, refresh-while-signed-in->Home all work; (7) FAB->/assessment shows both Option 1 Quick Analysis and Option 2 Enhanced Analysis (Multiple Photos + Clinical History); (8) network capture shows ZERO calls to *.emergentagent.com/api/* across the entire session. Source-level grep in /app/frontend/{app,src} for 'trial|activate|activation|device_activated|useTrial|TrialProvider|Device ID|GCash|gcash' returned zero matches; all deleted files (app/activate.tsx, src/trial.tsx, src/device.ts, src/components/ActivationCelebration.tsx, assets/images/gcash-qr.png) confirmed absent. No React Native or Expo deprecation issues detected in touched files. Deep scan-analysis/PDF regression was not re-executed (already verified in iteration 13) — the code paths for gemini, report and history are unchanged in this iteration.
critical_code_review_comments: app/_layout.tsx Gate correctly handles atRoot redirect to /(tabs) so refresh does not stick on bootstrap-screen — verified in test.
About screen no longer imports useTrial; License group fully removed (verified via grep and UI text scan).

The unused FastAPI backend still contains legacy activation endpoints (not called by app). Consider a follow-up cleanup, but harmless because EXPO_PUBLIC_BACKEND_URL is never hit by the frontend (0 network calls captured).
